description: Character-driven short-form anime drama with Japanese dialogue, English subtitles, source-backed real-person caricatures, and deterministic proof handling.
recommended_use: Dramatized re-tellings of real news, research, or external project narratives (e.g., the Glasswing/Mythos story this card was built for). NOT for first-person pitches of Rally itself — the cinematic anime aesthetic reads as 'ad-like' for a project-about-itself. For Rally pitches, use dev_pov_screen_capture or talking_head_no_face.
reference_notes: Character-driven scenes instead of explainer narration.
Use dramatic eye close-ups for high-stakes beats.
Use Japanese dialogue with English subtitles.
Use dark 90s cel-shaded anime, cinematic shadows, cold monitor light, and red warning glow.
Avoid moving mouths unless lip sync is explicitly required.

composition_rules: Every panel must work as a vertical crop.
Keep bottom 18 percent clear for subtitles.
Use repeated room anchors for dialogue scenes: table, screen, light direction, color palette.
Do not put exact generated text in the image unless it is decorative texture.

caption_treatment.style: large yellow subtitles with black backing box

default_routes.concept_hero: NB2 storyboard panel -> Seedance T2V/I2V if motion-critical; otherwise deterministic still motion
default_routes.talking_head: NB2 character still -> RunComfy lip sync when mouth movement is required
default_routes.likeness_critical_talking_head: source-backed NB2 still -> operator still approval -> RunComfy lip sync; never Seedance I2V before lip sync by default
default_routes.eye_closeup: NB2 still or Seedance T2V with explicit blink, eye dart, reflection, or push-in
default_routes.proof_card: deterministic render only; never generated evidence
default_routes.b_roll: Seedance T2V with explicit motion source

fallback_routes.talking_head: eye close-up with voiceover, or voiceover-only
fallback_routes.likeness_critical_talking_head: approved still with assembly motion, or eye close-up with voiceover
fallback_routes.proof_card: skip proof shot rather than fake evidence
fallback_routes.low_motion_video: regenerate only failed shot and downstream derived assets
